test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 11 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Who among the following revived Kuchipudi, started his own ‘Kuchipudi Dance Academy’ in Chennai and received ‘Padma Bhushan’ in the year 1998?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Guru Vempati Chinna Satyam.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** correct answer** is option 3, **Guru Vempati Chinna Satyam.**
 
• He was a renowned **Kuchipudi dancer and choreographer** who revived the art form and popularized it across India and the world.
 
• He started his own** Kuchipudi Dance Academy **in **Chennai** to teach and promote the **dance form.**
 
• He received many** awards and recognitions** for his contribution to the art form, including the **Padma Bhushan in 1998.**
 
• **Kelucharan Mohapatra, Uday Shankar, and Guru Bipin Singh** were also **renowned dancers and choreographers**, but they were not associated with Kuchipudi dance form.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kelucharan Mohapatra** was a famous **Odissi dancer **and **choreographer** who was instrumental in the revival of the classical dance form. 

 
 
• He received many awards and recognitions for his contribution to the art form, including the** Padma Vibhushan in 2000.**
 
 
 
• **Uday Shankar **was a pioneer of **modern dance** in India and was known for **fusing Indian classical dance** with **Western ballet and contemporary dance.** 
 
 
• He received many **awards and recognitions** for his contribution to the art form, including the **Padma Vibhushan in 1966.**
 
 
 
• **Guru Bipin Singh **was a noted** Manipuri dancer **and** choreographer **who popularized the dance form in** India and abroad**.
 
 
• He received many awards and recognitions for his contribution to the art form, including the** Padma Shri in 1972.**
